schema.terminal_persisted: compatibility alias: final returned decision index was successfully persisted; never sufficient for acceptance
schema.terminal_index_persisted: the final returned decision index was persisted; if repair failed an older FINALIZING index may still exist
schema.finalization_proven: both consumption references and artifacts read-verified before the final atomic index publication; false after finalization faults
schema.claim_finalization: PROVEN or UNPROVEN; independent of status, so a proven BLOCKED group is still a refusal

migrations: All 227 previous pytest nodeids retained; successful EXPIRED claim still must hash the exact canonical terminal bytes.
Public maximum helper extracted without changing nine existing test IDs or their phase/debit/capacity/ref rejection obligations.
Added local EXPIRED/hash check and finalization_proven to all old public chains; consumption result cannot equal READY_FOR_REVIEW.
New UNPROVEN fallback branches may retain original RUNNING shared claim; this is tested only for injected finalization faults, not used to weaken old successful-chain EXPIRED assertions.
Factory binary/source copies replaced by per-file textual size/hash inventory before cleanup; required raw command/observer/phase/life data retained.
